text: Ledger Android: entry types, dialog, rows, balances, Ledger wording

Landed in 34d8f80, e3409c8, d407c40, 3567d41 (Opus agent, reviewed, cherry-picked). Android: ExpenseType/type, type-aware ExpenseMath (settled, spentTotals, entryEffectCents) driven by the shared table incl. spent/effect groups and settled, seeded property test; signedNumber; dialog (segmented Expense|Income|Transfer, From/To dropdowns), rows, Balances, overview net; both web-ticket test concessions removed. Deviations from web, all deliberate: segmented control instead of radios (design section 3), untouched edit of an old entry writes nothing (T-88). Full gate green on main.
